subject: reasoning
question: Harit starts from Point Y and drives 47 km towards the east. He then takes a right turn, drives 23 km, turns right and drives 26 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 52 km. He takes a left turn, drives 21 km. He then turns left, drives 11 km to stop at Point Z. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point Y again? (All turns are 90-degree turns only unless specified.)
solution:
Given:

Harit starts from Point Y and drives 47 km towards the east.

He then takes a right turn, drives 23 km, turns right and drives 26 km.

He then takes a right turn and drives 52 km.

He takes a left turn, drives 21 km.

He then turns left, drives 11 km to stop at Point Z.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/295a94422052d87c72ab7b8f7c8ab7cc4006770e879f5d856084d5fffa75b290.png] 

Harit's final position (Point Z) is at a distance of 18 km from Point Y, and it's located to the North.

To reach Point Y again, he must drive **18 km in the South** direction.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
